Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/36338

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/2834

Candidate parent: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2736 at `21e526df7844155adec0c2163992178bf899ba99`

Independent review parent: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2799

## What changed

Preserves the candidate selective FP8-to-BF16 dequantization and remapping path, but adds a pre-deduplication gate based on top-k input size. Large query-by-top-k inputs now choose full dequantization before allocating remap intermediates or running `torch.unique`. The candidate test was also moved into the current registered-test taxonomy.

## Failing before / passing after

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X with 131,072 prefix rows and top-k 2,048, the exact candidate reproduced the review:

- 64 queries: selective, 1.519x full latency, 100,483,584-byte peak
- 256 queries: late full fallback, 1.993x, 166,724,096-byte peak
- 1,024 queries: late full fallback, 2.291x, 213,910,016-byte peak
- full path peak: 150,994,944 bytes

After correction, the 64/256/1,024-query cases fall back before deduplication, measure 0.795x/0.802x/0.827x of the separately warmed full baseline, and each peaks at exactly 150,994,944 bytes. The preserved 262,144-row, 8-query compact case remains selective: 2.500x speedup and 4,641,408 compact BF16 bytes versus 301,989,888 full bytes.

## Reproduction

- `PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python .../venv/bin/python reports/j-2eee0f89730e/evidence/adversarial_scaling.py`
- `PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python .../venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/kernel/ops/attention/test_selective_dsa_kv_dequant.py` (4 passed)
- `/opt/venv/bin/pre-commit run --files ...` (all applicable hooks passed)

Raw before/after logs and the complete test report are under `reports/j-2eee0f89730e/`.

## Remaining limitation

BF16 `flashmla_sparse` attention output and end-to-end sparse-prefill performance remain unverified because the assigned MI355X is not NVIDIA Hopper/Blackwell. The ROCm backend fixture stops before attention because page size 64 is unsupported by the available legacy HIP DSA path, which requires page size 1. This architecture limitation is recorded and was not used to justify a speculative source change. No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
